title: Civic Data Sources
description: Citations for the published government documents and pages that every Better Dagupan civic record is verified against.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by civic records. Never reused for a different document.

agency.description: Government body that published the document.

title.description: Title of the document or page as published.

url.description: Exact URL the data was read from.

published.description: Date the publisher released this edition of the document. Null when the publisher states none. Not the same as data_as_of.

data_as_of.description: Reference date the content describes, as stated by the publisher. A dataset released on one date commonly describes an earlier one, so this is recorded separately from published.

coverage.description: Human-readable period the content covers, for documents that describe a span rather than a single date (e.g. a term of office). Used to label historical content as historical.

verified.description: Date the records citing this source were last checked against it.

licence.description: Reuse terms stated by the publisher. Null means the publisher states none.

notes.description: What this source establishes, and any limits on it. The only optional field: omit it when there is nothing to qualify.

derives_from.description: Id of the authoritative source this document redistributes. A derivative source corroborates availability, not the facts themselves, and must not be the sole citation for a published field.

items.description: A citation. Every field except `notes` is required, including the ones whose value is often null: a citation must state that a publisher gives no publication date, rather than leave the reader unable to tell an absent date from an unrecorded one. `notes` is the sole optional field, because a source with no caveat needs none and an empty string would say nothing. Mirrors the CivicSource interface in src/types/civicSourceTypes.ts.
